```{r}
#| output: asis
#| label: tbl-patients-exposed
#| tbl-cap: !expr 'sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$`tbl-cap`'
#| tbl-cap-location: top

# The table stands in a slot of its own of the calculated datasets; a dataset
# saved before it carries neither the slot nor the inputs the getter reads,
# and the table prints its no-data note then.
# NEOIPC-PERMANENT(dataset-format): never let this read fail. A stored
# reference dataset outlives every release, and this report renders a dataset
# saved before the table existed no matter how far compatibility moves on.
pe_data <- if (!is.null(reference_data$patients_exposed_table)) {
  reference_data$patients_exposed_table
} else {
  tryCatch(neoipcr::get_patients_exposed_table(reference_data),
           error = function(e) NULL)
}

# The dataset table arrives long, one row per factor and measure; the table
# gives each measure its own columns over the eight factors. The count of
# departments behind the quartiles is dropped: beside the quartiles it would
# print a bare number that no text of the table explains. The mean days come
# without intervals: the dataset carries none for the mean, whose bootstrap
# would count a department's exposed patients as independent of one another.
if (is.null(pe_data)) {
  no_data_table(sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$no_data)
} else {
  tbl_data <- pe_data |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = "factor",
      names_from = "measure",
      values_from = -c("factor", "measure"),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{measure}") |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::starts_with("quartile_departments")) |>
    dplyr::select(-tidyselect::any_of(c(
      "ci_lower_mean_days", "ci_upper_mean_days",
      "q1_ci_lower_mean_days", "q1_ci_upper_mean_days",
      "q2_ci_lower_mean_days", "q2_ci_upper_mean_days",
      "q3_ci_lower_mean_days", "q3_ci_upper_mean_days"))) |>
    dplyr::rename(
      count_exp = "n_patients_exposed",
      pooled_exp = "pooled_patients_exposed",
      ci_lower_exp = "ci_lower_patients_exposed",
      ci_upper_exp = "ci_upper_patients_exposed",
      q1_exp = "q1_patients_exposed",
      q2_exp = "q2_patients_exposed",
      q3_exp = "q3_patients_exposed",
      q1_ci_lower_exp = "q1_ci_lower_patients_exposed",
      q1_ci_upper_exp = "q1_ci_upper_patients_exposed",
      q2_ci_lower_exp = "q2_ci_lower_patients_exposed",
      q2_ci_upper_exp = "q2_ci_upper_patients_exposed",
      q3_ci_lower_exp = "q3_ci_lower_patients_exposed",
      q3_ci_upper_exp = "q3_ci_upper_patients_exposed",
      count_days = "n_mean_days",
      pooled_days = "pooled_mean_days",
      q1_days = "q1_mean_days",
      q2_days = "q2_mean_days",
      q3_days = "q3_mean_days")

  ci_pattern <- ci_pattern_inline

  tbl <- tbl_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      factor = dplyr::recode_values(
        as.character(.data$factor),
        "cvc" ~ sR$cvc,
        "pvc" ~ sR$pvc,
        "inv" ~ sR$inv,
        "niv" ~ sR$niv,
        "ab" ~ sR$`tbl-risk-density-rates`$any_antibiotic,
        "human_milk" ~ sR$human_milk_sc,
        "probiotic" ~ sR$probiotics_sc,
        "kangaroo_care" ~ sR$kangaroo_care_sc)) |>
    gt(rowname_col = "factor") |>
    sub_missing() |>
    gt::tab_options(
      latex.use_longtable = TRUE,
      table.width = pct(100),
      table.font.size = if (ci_config == "none") 10 else 9,
      footnotes.marks = "extended"
    ) |>
    # Every value column but the counts, the interval bounds included: the
    # merges below splice what these formats print, so an unformatted bound
    # would reach the cell at full precision and the wrong decimal mark.
    fmt_number(
      columns = !tidyselect::any_of(c("count_exp", "count_days")),
      decimals = 1,
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2,
      locale = locale_gt) |>
    fmt_integer(
      columns = tidyselect::all_of(c("count_exp", "count_days")),
      sep_mark = sR$digit_group_separator,
      min_sep_threshold = 2) |>
    cols_label(
      count_exp = sR$table_headers$count,
      pooled_exp = sR$table_headers$pooled,
      q1_exp = sR$table_headers$q1,
      q2_exp = sR$table_headers$q2,
      q3_exp = sR$table_headers$q3,
      count_days = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$total_days,
      pooled_days = sR$table_headers$pooled,
      q1_days = sR$table_headers$q1,
      q2_days = sR$table_headers$q2,
      q3_days = sR$table_headers$q3) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$patients_exposed,
      columns = tidyselect::all_of(c(
        "count_exp", "pooled_exp", "q1_exp", "q2_exp", "q3_exp")),
      id = "span_exposed") |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$mean_days,
      columns = tidyselect::all_of(c(
        "count_days", "pooled_days", "q1_days", "q2_days", "q3_days")),
      id = "span_days") |>
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
      locations = list(
        cells_column_spanners(),
        cells_column_labels(),
        cells_row_groups()
      )
    )

  # Pooled and quartile intervals, on the share's own columns: the mean days
  # print without any.
  if (include_pooled_ci && "ci_lower_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::cols_merge(
        columns = c(pooled_exp, ci_lower_exp, ci_upper_exp),
        pattern = ci_pattern,
        rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_exp))
  } else if ("ci_lower_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    tbl <- tbl |> gt::cols_hide(
      columns = tidyselect::any_of(c("ci_lower_exp", "ci_upper_exp")))
  }

  if ("q1_ci_lower_exp" %in% colnames(tbl$`_data`)) {
    if (include_quartile_ci) {
      has_boot <- !is.na(tbl$`_data`[["q1_ci_lower_exp"]])
      tbl <- tbl |>
        gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q1_exp, q1_ci_lower_exp, q1_ci_upper_exp),
                       pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot) |>
        gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q2_exp, q2_ci_lower_exp, q2_ci_upper_exp),
                       pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot) |>
        gt::cols_merge(columns = c(q3_exp, q3_ci_lower_exp, q3_ci_upper_exp),
                       pattern = ci_pattern, rows = has_boot)
    } else {
      tbl <- tbl |> gt::cols_hide(columns = tidyselect::any_of(c(
        "q1_ci_lower_exp", "q1_ci_upper_exp",
        "q2_ci_lower_exp", "q2_ci_upper_exp",
        "q3_ci_lower_exp", "q3_ci_upper_exp")))
    }
  }

  tbl <- tbl |>
    cols_width(
      stub() ~ pct(16),
      count_exp ~ pct(7), pooled_exp ~ pct(13),
      q1_exp ~ pct(9), q2_exp ~ pct(9), q3_exp ~ pct(9),
      count_days ~ pct(7), pooled_days ~ pct(13),
      q1_days ~ pct(9), q2_days ~ pct(9), q3_days ~ pct(9)) |>
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = sR$`tbl-patients-exposed`$abbreviations_footnote,
      locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "span_exposed"),
      placement = "right")

  # Sparse-data footnote for N < sparse_threshold
  if (any(!is.na(tbl_data$pooled_exp) & tbl_data$count_exp < sparse_threshold,
          na.rm = TRUE)) {
    fn_text <- interpolate_translation(
      if (include_pooled_ci) sR$sparse_data_footnote
      else sR$sparse_data_footnote_no_ci,
      threshold = sparse_threshold)
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_footnote(
        footnote = fn_text,
        locations = cells_body(
          columns = count_exp,
          rows = !is.na(tbl_data$pooled_exp) &
            tbl_data$count_exp < sparse_threshold),
        placement = "right")
  }

  tbl
}
```
